patterns.note: Asymmetrical, minimalist layout with generous negative space, creating an editorial, gallery-like feel reminiscent of a print publication.
Prominent use of a large, bold sans-serif for branding and key headings, contrasted with a more standard sans-serif for body text and a monospaced font for numerical data in lists.
A stark monochrome palette of black, white, and subtle grey for all UI elements, allowing the visual content (artwork) to introduce any color.
A sticky header containing the main brand mark ('B&F') and a subtle navigation indicator (two dots) remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the page content scrolls underneath.
Content sections are revealed sequentially by scrolling up into the viewport, creating a continuous flow of information as the user scrolls down the page.
A unique 'work list' section presented as a simple, unstyled table with project titles, years, and sequential numbers, resembling a digital index or archive.

technique_notes: The main branding element and a small navigation indicator are fixed to the top of the viewport, allowing page content to scroll beneath them, maintaining brand presence.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls, appearing to slide up from the bottom of the screen, creating a smooth, continuous reading experience.
A decorative clock element in the footer uses CSS keyframe animations to simulate real-time movement of its hands, adding a subtle, dynamic artistic touch.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful display headings (e.g., 'B&F') and section titles (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy down to small, legible body text and even smaller metadata.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant negative space around content blocks, especially in the hero and between major sections, creating a gallery-like density.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extreme minimalism and editorial, almost gallery-like presentation. It deliberately avoids conventional navigation and marketing patterns, instead offering a curated, scrolling exhibition of work, emphasized by large, impactful typography and abundant white space. The animated clock in the footer serves as a unique, subtle artistic detail.
